artMeta._readme: v3 (2026-09-22): the runtime reads artMeta.v3 (src/layers.ts). Every PNG is trimmed to its alpha box and placed at `box` on the 832x1216 plate canvas. Provenance per file under artMeta.provenance; how to rebuild: tools/gen/rig-build.sh. The v2 record is kept under artMeta.v2.

bodyTurned._readme: rig-collar.py: the body with the tassel footprint inpainted; drawn for turned keys, faded in across a frontal-to-turn blend

warp._readme: src/warp.ts: frame + pins are fixed points shared by every key; with the key landmarks they are Delaunay-triangulated per bracket (on the pair's midpoint set) and both keys are warped to the interpolated landmarks.

retiredKeys._readme: rig-turns.py: out of keys[] since v3.1. q34-right's painting faces LEFT (it is turn-l45 now); q34-left barely turns (about 15 degrees) and would put a second hair repaint inside the idle sway; profile-left/right had their visible iris colours backwards (turn-l85 / turn-r85 replace them).

v3.keyLidsReadme: tools/gen/rig-lids.py: per key, lid frames by aperture (nearest wins); transparent below the lid edge

v2._readme: See ../README.md for the full write-up. Everything under artMeta is this pass's fuller record (per-layer files/boxes, named landmarks with visibility+confidence, judge verdicts, known issues) — the runtime's Rig interface (src/rig.ts) only reads the sibling top-level keys above; nothing here is consumed by loadRig today.
v2.commonLandmarkNote: Only 8 of up to 31 named points are visible on *all four* keys at once (mostly centreline points — the profile key hides one whole side, and the far eye is occluded by hair on both q34 keys), so that is what keys[].landmarks carries, in this fixed order, for index-based correspondence across keys. The full named set per key, including occluded/not-visible points and their confidence, is in landmarks/<key>.json — read that for anything needing more than 8-point correspondence.

profile-right.note: FAILED across 5 rounds (keys.md, judge.md) — wrong-handed turn every time. Not built into this rig; right-side yaw stops at q34-right (yawDeg 40). Least-bad candidate kept on disk (art/keys/picked/profile-right.pick1.webp) for a future mirror+inpaint attempt.

headFlat.note: hairBack+headCore+apertures+irises+hairFront+strands+earring, pre-composited (everything except body) — this is keys[0].file above.

q34-left.note: Coarser than the frontal breakdown by design — headCore + hair only, no separate front/back hair or strands for a yaw key. See ../README.md.

q34-right.note: Coarser than the frontal breakdown by design — headCore + hair only, no separate front/back hair or strands for a yaw key. See ../README.md.

profile-left.note: Coarser than the frontal breakdown by design — headCore + hair only, no separate front/back hair or strands for a yaw key. See ../README.md.

landmarks.namingConvention: RIG-relative sides: '_R' is HER right (sampled green at PLATE_ANCHORS.pupils[0] on the frontal plate); '_L' is her left (sampled blue at pupils[1]). Not viewer-relative.
landmarks.pivot: chin point per key (survives yaw); see each landmarks/<key>.json.

knownIssues: The earring's canon side is inconsistently stated across this run's own docs (keys/judge.md says 'the same side as her blue eye'; direct pixel sampling of the frontal plate shows it on the GREEN-eye side) — flagged, not resolved. See README.md.

profile-left's `place` alignment input (chin=[215,690] on the raw candidate) was imprecise; the visually true chin sits closer to (350,700), recorded as such in landmarks/profile-left.json, but the key's overall scale/position is still calibrated to the original (slightly off) point. See README.md.
Hidden-region inpainting (forehead under bangs, cheek under a strand, neck under the jaw) was not attempted — the gap only shows once a layer is actually displaced by the driver. See README.md.

patches/patches.json's ['hurt'] group(s) have no box/pad/feather (nothing was attempted for them) and do not fit the runtime's PatchGroup shape, so they are left out of the embedded `patches` above rather than embedded malformed. Fix at the source (patches/patches.json) once that group has real geometry, and this embedding will pick it up automatically.
